==Treasure Trails==
===Hard===
* '''Bolkoy:''' Hello! I take it you're here about the trail?
* '''Player:''' Yes, do you have a challenge for me?
* '''Bolkoy:''' Yes, right here!
* {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (hard) detail.png|Bolkoy has given you a challenge scroll!}}
* {{tact|receives=a challenge scroll}}
* {{tact|end}}

====Talking to him again====
* '''Bolkoy:''' Please enter the answer to the question.
* {{tcond|When given the wrong answer:}}
** '''Bolkoy:''' What's the matter with you? Can't you count? Try harder!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|When given the right answer:}}
** '''Bolkoy:''' Lucky for you, that's the right answer!
** {{tcond|When given another clue scroll:}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (hard) detail.png|Bolkoy has given you another clue scroll!}}
*** {{tact|receives=a clue scroll}}
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|When given a reward casket:}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Reward casket (hard) detail.png|You've obtained a casket!}}
*** {{tact|receives=a reward casket}}
*** {{tact|end}}
